shortDescription: Every field in this file is a placeholder. The gate holds it out of the feed until the real values are in.
showNotes:
This file is the shape of an episode record, committed so there is something to copy.

It is deliberately failing the publishing gate — `audio.bytes` is 0, `audio.durationSeconds` is 0, and the guest release is unsigned — so it can never reach the feed by accident. The /health route lists exactly which fields are holding it back.

To publish the real episode 1:

- Upload the MP3 to R2 and copy the exact byte size off the object listing
- Fill in `audio.url`, `audio.bytes`, and `audio.durationSeconds`
- Replace the title, descriptions, chapters, and guest block
- Set `releaseSigned` to true only once the signed release is actually on file
- Replace `episodes/001.vtt` with the real transcript
